question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Vishal is going to read the story _________.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Aloud.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct option to fill in the blank is** "aloud" (Option 3).**
 
• The word** "aloud"** means **to speak or read something audibly or loudly. **
